Synthetic test media generated for the background editor regression:

- `crop.png`: 320 × 160 red/blue split, used for framing and zoom.
- `delays.gif`: red/green/blue with 120/400/180 ms frame delays.
- `trim-source.mp4`: 160 × 90 H.264, 10 FPS; one second each of red, green and blue.

These are test signals generated locally, not source/reference footage.
